svg.title: Figure 9. Process Flow of the Proposed System
svg.desc: The system helps staff record vaccinations and plan visits. The regular clinic day is Wednesday. Staff choose another date when needed and write the reason.

g.text: FIGURE 9. PROCESS FLOW OF THE PROPOSED SYSTEM
Example workflow; staff choose which action is needed
Check that it is not repeated
Write a reason for another day
Demo: no real text is sent
Choose a record; check its dates
This is not a health assessment
HOLIDAYS: staff choose another clinic date, such as Thursday, and record the reason.
